policy: One outer UTC/monotonic anchor; effective outer deadline=min(anchor+Minutes,userFinishBy), child FinishBy=effective outer deadline-5s even when user FinishBy is absent or later. Reject remaining windows<=5s before dispatch. Requested window, effective deadlines and cleanup reserve remain separate manifest fields.

red.observations: Missing effective manifest fields and old 1.2 s stuck-child dispatch reproduced the required changes.

first_post_fix_attempt.disposition: The earlier-absolute assertion formatted a JSON-materialized DateTime through a string, losing fractional precision/offset identity. Test now casts directly to DateTimeOffset and compares UTC ticks; production timing code unchanged between attempts.

final.cases: Missing finish, later finish, earlier absolute finish, cleanup-consumed window rejection, real six-second stuck bootstrap/tree kill, canonical locks, source validation and post-dispatch reporting failure.
final.command: Set existing SPICE_SOAK_TEST_ROOT, SPICE_SOAK_SOURCE_ROOT and SPICE_ENDURANCE_SUPERVISOR_DLL; Invoke-Pester -Path scripts/tests/SoakSupervision.Tests.ps1,scripts/tests/VerifiedSoak.Tests.ps1 with CodeCoverage.Path=scripts/Run-VerifiedSoak.ps1

coverage.branch_coverage: Unavailable from Pester; no branch percentage invented.
coverage.limits: Launcher only. Background dispatch, mutation-tool setup, ancestor artifact-junction and several failure branches were not executed by this test scope. Child numerical code is unmeasured.

soak-slow-*.error: Outer soak deadline reached; setup/build/test tree terminated. Inspect partial summary; do not claim a full run.

soak-short-*.error: Remaining soak window must exceed the five-second cleanup reserve before dispatch.

partial_preflight.launcher_error: Outer soak deadline reached; setup/build/test tree terminated. Inspect partial summary; do not claim a full run.
partial_preflight.classification: Partial: outer killed child before inner finalization. Running checkpoint with no finished timestamp is not a completed or passing campaign. Prior launcher did not record its exact outer-clock anchor; manifest start is retained as metadata, not an invented exact dispatch timestamp.

limits: No new long campaign was started; finite launcher fixtures are not numerical or overnight qualification. The earlier second preflight remains partial.

The five-second cleanup reserve is unchanged; the prior 1.2 s fixture now verifies rejection, with a separate 6 s fixture verifying actual outer cleanup. No test-only production hook or budget inflation.

No native numerical, Stryker, fuzz/property or fresh managed coverage campaign was required for this launcher-only correction; numerical properties and fixed independent oracle evidence remain separate.

Existing exFAT Git-ownership rejection is exercised fail-closed by the unrelated-repository contract without changing global Git configuration. Timer/OS scheduling and forced parent termination remain platform limitations.
